description: This file defines the FreeCheckout model class responsible for providing payment method options specific to free checkout within the OpenCart ecommerce platform. It determines availability based on cart totals and subscription status, and provides method data for use elsewhere in the application.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Model class handling the logic for offering free checkout payment method based on cart total and subscription status.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns available payment methods based on current cart and subscription status.
